name: @wezzard/mcp-x-articles
description: MCP server and multi-agent plugin for publishing Markdown files as X Articles via the official X API v2 Articles endpoints: deterministic Markdown conversion, zero-token media upload, macOS Keychain secret storage, and two-step human review.
